settings.description: Register entry D3 (spec/V0.8-DECISIONS.md, #134): the decode-side synthesis window at codes 3 and 4, each tier decided separately. The arms are synthesis-window-upper's at tier 3 and tier 4, plus two lighter tapers (w_min 0.95 and 0.9), with every one of the four window knobs pinned in every arm, the shipped arms included, so no arm inherits a window a later default ships. The window is decoder-side and the shipped encoder runs no pixel-domain refinement (refine_passes 0), so every arm of a tier encodes the same bytes; expectBytes holds each tier to its shipped length per alpha mode. Each window arm at code k is read three ways (D3's 'How the primary metric is read'): its spurious detail on the 32 px pinned grid against 't2 shipped (no window)', the floor of EXPERIMENTS.md 13.2, which is a comparison across two byte counts (108/103 B against 411/388 B or 1623/1528 B) and is the entry's primary metric; and its ΔE00 and guards against its own tier's shipped arm, at equal bytes. Corpus all with realOnly and the white-black-grey backdrops, as D1's and D2's: the photographic, alpha and graphics tune images, so a holdout3 read covers every stratum. Rows against the code-2 arm on any metric but spurious, which the printed tables show by default, are at other byte counts and are not judged.
